security_scope: All current app files; all locally reachable blobs and commit messages; all remote branch/tag tips available locally before visibility change
limits: Pattern scan and scoped human content/history review are not an exhaustive security guarantee
Offline validation checks recorded authenticated/public API proofs; does not repeat remote authentication
Vercel qualification is documentary, not eligibility determination, provider validation or deploy approval
Full parent integration authorization not received; no Git operation parameters invented
Patch files exclude themselves to avoid circular diffs
